answer: Because the horizon decay is applied at each close, the zephyr audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 29% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the lotus fee to keep them eligible. A 460 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
